env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd m
logos run -p=1 .
stdout '^ok local-const-map-copy$'
! logos build -p=1 -o $WORK/bin/bad$GOEXE ./bad
stderr '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'
cp ordinary.txt bad/main.lgo
logos build -p=1 -o $WORK/bin/ordinary$GOEXE ./bad

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/pass6map

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package main

import "fmt"

const original = map[string]int{"a": 1, "b": 2}

const func touch(m map[string]int) int {
	m["a"] = 99
	delete(m, "b")
	return m["a"] ?? -1
}

const changed = touch(original)

func main() {
	if changed != 99 || (original["a"] ?? -1) != 1 || (original["b"] ?? -1) != 2 || len(original) != 2 {
		panic("copy")
	}
	fmt.Println("ok local-const-map-copy")
}

-- m/lib/lib.lgo --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package lib

func Read(m map[string]int) int { return m["a"] ?? -1 }

-- m/bad/main.lgo --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package main

import "example.com/pass6map/lib"

const original = map[string]int{"a": 1}

func main() { _ = lib.Read(original) }

-- m/ordinary.txt --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package main

import "example.com/pass6map/lib"

var original = map[string]int{"a": 1}

func main() { _ = lib.Read(original) }
